core.headline: Edwardian country house with 4.5 acres, pool and annexe
core.listing:
Brook Hall is a detached Edwardian country house set in approximately 4.5 acres near Frant. The gated drive opens onto grounds that include formal gardens, a heated outdoor pool and a three-acre paddock. A public footpath crosses the southern edge of the paddock. The property lies within the High Weald National Landscape.

Built in 1908, the house has brick construction with tile-hung upper elevations under a clay-tiled roof. The ground floor offers four reception rooms: a drawing room measuring 7.10m x 5.20m (23'4" x 17'1"), a dining room measuring 5.40m x 4.60m (17'9" x 15'1"), a study and a garden room. The kitchen/breakfast room measures 8.20m x 4.90m (26'11" x 16'1").

There are five bedrooms and four bathrooms. The principal bedroom measures 5.60m x 4.80m (18'4" x 15'9").

The gardens include a terrace and a heated outdoor pool served by an air source heat pump. An oak-framed triple cart lodge built in 2025 houses a one-bedroom annexe above. Permission for the cart lodge with annexe was granted in 2025. The paddock extends to approximately three acres.

Frant station lies approximately 2 miles away, with services to London Bridge in approximately 1 hour. Royal Tunbridge Wells is approximately 4 miles distant.

Guide Price £2,100,000. Freehold. Council Tax Band H (Wealden District Council). EPC rating E. Construction: standard – brick with tile-hung upper elevations under a clay-tiled roof. Mains electricity and water (not metered); treatment plant; oil-fired central heating. FTTC broadband; mobile signal limited indoors with good outdoor coverage. Gated drive with parking for several cars; triple cart lodge. The property lies within the High Weald National Landscape. A public footpath crosses the southern edge of the paddock. Permission was granted in 2025 for the cart lodge with annexe above (built). Council tax banding of the annexe has not been confirmed.
core.summary: Detached Edwardian country house in approximately 4.5 acres with gated drive, heated outdoor pool, three-acre paddock and oak-framed triple cart lodge with one-bedroom annexe, near Frant.
